reason: Our agent volume is tiny today, so there's nothing urgent to govern yet, and I don't put a new vendor in the trade path before Robinhood or Coinbase show me what agent controls are supposed to look like. I'd revisit in a couple of quarters, not this month.
objection: A startup with no customers and no SOC 2 asking to sit as a proxy in front of our order and payment flow. Vendor risk would kill that in review, and the LOI naming a price makes even the 'free' pilot a commitment I can't justify on today's volume.
would_change_my_mind: Robinhood or Coinbase publicly rolling out agent-identity and approval controls (or FINRA putting out guidance that expects them), plus a finished SOC 2 Type II.
